business_summary.text: Signatureglobal is a real estate developer focused on residential and commercial projects in Gurugram and Delhi NCR, with a strategy of continuous supply creation and diversification into branded residences and commercial developments.

call_points.text: New launch guidance for FY27 held at ₹15,000 Cr of GDV, with launches planned around Diwali and in Q4.
Average realisation rose above ₹17,000/sq ft in Q1 from a little above ₹15,000/sq ft for all of last year.
Land business development for the year is guided at ₹1,500-1,800 Cr, including markets outside Delhi NCR.
Management expects to complete and recognise revenue of over ₹5,000 Cr in FY27.
Construction cost escalation has run at 7-8% a year over the past decade; no unusual spike seen last quarter.
Cash and bank balances are close to ₹2,500 Cr and net debt under ₹390 Cr; net debt may rise modestly with land buys.
On collections timing, management said it cannot name the quarter when sales convert to collections.

guidance.statement: Pre-sales of about ₹10,000 Cr for FY27
New launches worth ₹15,000 Cr of GDV for FY27
Completions and revenue recognition of over ₹5,000 Cr in FY27
Land business development spend of ₹1,500-1,800 Cr for the year

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Realty > Residential, Commercial Projects

operating_notes.text: FY26 pre-sales of ₹82.5 billion, with about half from new launches and over 5 million sq ft and 2,100-plus units sold
FY26 average realisation on completed area was about ₹6,800-6,900 per sq ft, with gross margin about 30% and EBITDA margin 9-10%
RMZ JV covers 5.5 million sq ft in Sector 71, with partners anticipating capital value in excess of ₹150 billion
Q1FY27 average realisation was over ₹17,000/sq ft against a little above ₹15,000/sq ft for all of FY26, helped by the Tonino Lamborghini launch at over ₹22,000/sq ft.
About 23 million sq ft launched since February 2024 carries a GDV of ₹334 billion, of which ₹230-240 billion of sales has been achieved.
A forthcoming portfolio of about 17 million sq ft includes 5 million sq ft of commercial development tied up with the RMZ group, announced in March.

timeline.summary: Signatureglobal held Q4 FY26 earnings call on 14th May 2026, guiding FY27 launches at ₹15,000 Cr and pre-sales at ₹10,000 Cr with net debt near zero
On 6 August 2026 Signatureglobal's Q1FY27 call kept FY27 guidance at ₹10,000 Cr pre-sales and ₹15,000 Cr of new launches, after about ₹2,000 Cr of pre-sales and ₹670 Cr of collections in the quarter.

watchlist.response: Management said it does not want to sound aggressive and that the collection and completion numbers are fairly achievable
watchlist.text: Collections guidance cut from about ₹6,000 Cr to about ₹4,000 Cr in FY26; analyst asked why FY27 guidance of ₹5,000 Cr is not higher

watchlist.response: Called it an aberration from lumpy milestones slipping into the next quarter and said it expects to return to about ₹1,100 Cr a quarter, but could not name the quarter when sales convert to collections.
watchlist.text: Collections fell well below the usual quarterly run-rate.

watchlist.response: Said a good portion of FY27 launches is planned in Sector 71 because there is very little competing supply there, and some launches will be outside those micro-markets.
watchlist.text: Whether the H2 launch pipeline can be concentrated in one micro-market (SPR/Sector 71).
